name: jerry blevins retarded gay adventure
source: Follow Encyclopedia Dramatica Discord user "Retarded_FAG" a.k.a. Jerry Blevins on adventures on the internet and in Brazil to find monkey head soup.
translation: 跟随《戏剧百科》（Encyclopedia Dramatica）的Discord用户“Retarded_FAG”（真名杰里·布莱文斯），踏上横跨互联网与巴西的奇葩冒险之旅，只为寻找传说中的猴头汤。
